summary: Wasco County, OR: a crow's nest on the 95-foot level of a large tree, dated to 1933 and described as abandoned but still there.

corrections.why: The lookout is a crow's nest in a tree. data/vocab.json files crow's nests under platform (open tower or platform, no cab), not tower. The 2013 post gives the type as crow's nest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record notes that sources disagree on whether a tower, a building, a camp or only a lookout tree stood here. Firelookout.com's page title says 'Fire Lookout Tower', but its text and Forest Lookouts both describe a crow's nest in a tree, and neither describes a building or camp.

notes_for_editor: Kind is the main correction: the text of all three pages describes a crow's nest in a tree, so 'tower' should be 'platform' under data/vocab.json (only Firelookout.com's page title says 'Fire Lookout Tower'). The story now says crow's nest and does not use the word platform, which no source uses. Height 29.0 m matches the 95-foot level of the tree (Forest Lookouts); it is the nest height, not a tower height. Standing rests on Firelookout.com's undated 'still there'; the 2013 post says abandoned and that a visitor could not find it on that trip, and the author says a later finder did, with no date. Treat present condition as unconfirmed. Elevation 3,333 ft (1015.9 m in the record) is from Firelookout.com and has no facts key. Access and visit left out: no source gives access, and the nest is up a tree, so we did not record a climbing route. Osborne panorama link is regional context; no source ties this photo to that survey. No new photos added. About 4 page reads and 1 WebSearch.
